title: High-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP)

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: An hs-CRP test measures very small increases in C-reactive protein, a protein the liver makes in response to inflammation. It is used to estimate a person's risk of heart conditions.
context: An hs-CRP test and a standard CRP test both measure C-reactive protein but are used for different purposes. Many everyday factors can affect CRP levels, so the result is considered along with other information.
aboveRange: Higher levels may be associated with a greater estimated risk of heart conditions
May be associated with inflammation in the body from many causes
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
